cases.name: Kelly "Keli" Kay McGinness
cases.about:
She ran away from home and became involved in commercial sex work sometime after being raped at 13 by a group of young men. By 1983 she had given birth to two children with her pimp, Raphael Wilson. Her oldest child, a son, was placed up for adoption and her four-month-old daughter had been in a foster home after Kelly was incarcerated for commercial sex work. She intended to retrieve her daughter after her release, but went missing before the reunion.

https://andtheywere.wordpress.com/2016/08/21/kelly-mcginniss-green-river/
cases.caseStatus: COLD CASE UNSOLVED; NO BODY CASE; SUSPECT BUT NOT TRIED
cases.narrative:
Her body has never been recovered but he claimed responsibility for killing her and said her strangled her in his truck.

Ridgway is certain that he killed Ms. McGinniss and left her body near Lake Fenwick, but her body was never located. Therefore, Ridgway has not been prosecuted for her murder.

http://www.doenetwork.org/cases/385dfwa.html

He admitted he strangled her.
